name: – Riho Terras – After § 63 – Am 2
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Kosovo
part_text: 63a. Notes the implementation gaps affecting strategic east-west connectivity across the region, thus limiting the real gains for the EU; invites Kosovo to propose concrete timelines and monitoring, including under the Reform and Growth Facility, for the implementation of the expanded trans-European transport network (TEN-T);
